text:
The immediate-after constraints lock Hana–Gus–Dev into three consecutive slots and Finn–Ben into two. The two “exactly one between” constraints with Elif then force Elif two after Dev and Finn–Ben two after Elif, so the only pattern that fits in slots 1–9 is:

Hana, Gus, Dev, (open), Elif, Finn, Ben

Hana must start at slot 2. Starting at 1 puts Ivo after Finn; starting at 3 leaves Cara nowhere. Ann has to sit before Elif and after Hana, which fills the open slot. Cara is two after Finn, and Ivo takes the only remaining slot before Finn and at least three away from Ann.

That placement is the only one that meets every constraint. Cara in 1 with Finn–Ben in 6–7 does not.
